definitions.explanation: A sweet potato that has been slowly roasted, traditionally sold by street vendors in autumn and winter. A beloved Japanese comfort food.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{芋|いも}がおいしい{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's the season when roasted sweet potatoes are delicious.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{芋|いも}{屋|や}さんの{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえてきた。
examples.english: I could hear the voice of the roasted sweet potato vendor.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}い{日|ひ}にホクホクの{焼|や}き{芋|いも}を{食|た}べると{幸|しあわ}せな{気持|きも}ちになる。
examples.english: Eating a fluffy roasted sweet potato on a cold day makes you feel happy.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally sold from trucks or carts that drive through neighborhoods in autumn and winter, with the vendor calling out 「{石焼|いしや}き{芋|いも}〜」in a distinctive sing-song voice. The potatoes are slowly roasted over hot stones ({石焼|いしや}き), which gives them a caramelized sweetness. Modern convenience stores and supermarkets also sell machine-roasted versions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石焼|いしや}き{芋|いも} (stone-roasted sweet potato)
- {焼|や}き{芋|いも}{屋|や} (roasted sweet potato vendor)
- ホクホクの{焼|や}き{芋|いも} (fluffy roasted sweet potato)
